title: Analyst, Global Trade Compliance
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.

  
  
  

**Group/Division**

The Legal Compliance Organization (LCO) provides legal guidance to further KLA’s strategic objectives and protect and preserve the company's legal, ethical and financial integrity and reputation. Drawing on expertise in corporate law, commercial law, employment law, ethics and compliance, and intellectual property, the LCO offers strategic legal counsel that is informed by a clear understanding of the company’s business objectives and knowledge of the laws and regulations relevant to the business worldwide.

**What You'll Do**

In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Lead global trade compliance operational support across all regions, including export control blocks, restricted party screening escalations, HTS/ECCN classification, order release, shared inbox support, broker inquiries, and escalations.
* Review and validate import/export documentation, commercial invoice data, country of origin, customs value, part descriptions, shipment information, and related data required for compliant customs and export activity.
* Support U.S. and global export control reviews, including block resolution, ECCN validation, SPL screening escalations, license requirement assessment, sanctions/embargo considerations, and escalation of higher-risk transactions.
* Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, logistics, procurement, requestors, and regional stakeholders to resolve holds, missing documentation, classification questions, shipment delays, and urgent compliance requests.
* Own operational reporting controls, including SLA performance, request volumes, cycle time, aging, screening escalation activity, backlog, quality metrics, bottlenecks, and continuous improvement actions.
* Improve SOPs, work instructions, classification guidance, escalation procedures, training materials, governance documentation, and operating routines to strengthen process discipline and audit readiness.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in semiconductor, electronics, advanced manufacturing, shared services, or high-volume trade compliance operations.
* Experience with SAP, SAP GTS, Fiori, trade management systems, ServiceNow, Power BI, SharePoint, Excel, or similar tools.
* Ability to build trackers, dashboards, metrics, reporting controls, and exception reports; broker management, import audits, recordkeeping, process standardization, and LCB/CCS/CES certification preferred.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in a related field; 5+ years of experience in global trade compliance, import/export operations, customs compliance, or export controls.
* Hands-on experience with HTS/ECCN classification, export control blocks, SPL screening, customs documentation, valuation, country of origin, and shipment release requirements.
* Strong knowledge of EAR, sanctions controls, license requirements, controlled technology considerations, operational queues, escalations, data review, stakeholder communication, and timely follow-through.

**About KLA**

We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

  
  

**Use of AI Statement**

At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.

  
  

*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*

  

*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Legal Executive
description:
Position Details:

* **Role:** Legal Executive (M/F)
* **Industry:** Real Estate
* **Experience Required:** 2- 5 Years
* **Key Expertise:** Title Due Diligence, Title Verification, Property Documentation, Land & Real Estate Legal Matters
* **Notice Period:** Immediate Joiners / Less than 15 Days
* **Salary:** As per industry standards

Key Responsibilities:

**Title Due Diligence & Verification**

* Conduct detailed title due diligence for land and property acquisitions.
* Examine title documents, revenue records, encumbrance certificates, sale deeds, partition deeds, gift deeds, wills, and related property documents.
* Verify ownership history and chain of title for properties.
* Identify legal risks, encroachments, litigations, easements, and title defects.
* Prepare title search reports, legal opinions, and due diligence reports.
* Coordinate with external advocates, surveyors, and government authorities for title verification.

**Documentation & Agreements**

* Draft, review, and vet agreements including Sale Agreements, Lease Agreements, Development Agreements, Joint Development Agreements (JDA), Power of Attorney, MOUs, and Vendor Agreements.
* Ensure proper registration and stamping of legal documents.
* Support transaction closures and documentation compliance.

**Regulatory & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable property laws, RERA regulations, land laws, municipal laws, and local authority requirements.
* Liaise with Sub-Registrar Offices, Revenue Departments, Municipal Authorities, and other government bodies.
* Monitor legal compliance related to land acquisition and real estate transactions.

Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹420,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Legal Head- Real Estate
description:
We are looking for an experienced Legal Head to oversee legal operations, ensure regulatory compliance, manage legal risks and provide strategic legal advice across multiple business domains, including Real Estate, Healthcare, Medical Technology and Digital Health Solutions.

**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead and manage all legal affairs, legal documentation and compliance activities.
* Handle real estate legal matters, including land acquisition, property transactions, title verification and due diligence.
* Review and draft sale agreements, lease agreements, joint venture agreements and other property-related legal documents.
* Manage legal matters related to healthcare services, medical technology, and digital health platforms.
* Ensure compliance with applicable laws, regulations and industry-specific requirements.
* Handle litigation, arbitration, disputes and legal proceedings.
* Coordinate with external legal counsel, law firms, government authorities, and regulatory bodies.
* Advise senior management on legal risks, contractual obligations, and business decisions.
* Review and negotiate commercial contracts, vendor agreements, partnership agreements, and service-level agreements.
* Oversee corporate legal matters, including company agreements, board resolutions, and statutory documentation.
* Manage land-related disputes, property registration, encumbrances, and legal approvals.
* Ensure compliance with applicable healthcare, medical technology, data protection and privacy regulations.
* Develop legal policies, procedures and risk management strategies.
* Supervise the legal team and provide guidance on complex legal matters.
* Monitor changes in legislation and advise management on their potential business impact.
* Support mergers, acquisitions, joint ventures and other strategic business transactions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (LLB); Master's degree in Law (LLM) is an added advantage.
* 10–15 years of relevant legal experience, preferably in a senior legal leadership role.
* Strong experience in real estate law, property transactions, land acquisition and litigation.
* Knowledge of corporate law, contract management and regulatory compliance.
* Experience handling legal matters across multiple business sectors.
* Strong negotiation, analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management abilities.

**Key Skills**

* Real Estate & Property Law
* Land Acquisition & Legal Due Diligence
* Corporate & Commercial Law
* Contract Drafting & Negotiation
* Litigation & Dispute Resolution
* Healthcare & Medical Technology Compliance
* Regulatory Affairs & Risk Management
* Legal Documentation & Governance
* Team Leadership & Strategic Advisory

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can send their updated resume to:

manjugroups1986@gmail.com

Call / WhatsApp: 9840035103

Join Manju Groups and build your career in real estate!

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹150,000.00 per month

title: IT Security & Compliance Engineer
description:
We are committed to our core value of "Empathy," aiming to automate "demanding," "dirty," and "dangerous" jobs, and create a society where people can engage in more intellectual and creative work. By developing and supporting the implementation and operation of robotics platforms and robot solutions utilizing the world's most advanced control and coordination technologies, we strive to realize this vision.

**Role Overview**


We are looking for an experienced IT Security \& Compliance Engineer to manage the organization's cybersecurity operations, cloud security, compliance initiatives, and security governance. The ideal candidate should have hands\-on experience in security operations, Microsoft 365 security, vulnerability management, endpoint protection, identity \& access management, and ISO/NIST compliance frameworks.

 **Requirements** **Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor, investigate, and respond to security incidents, threats, malware, phishing, and ransomware attacks through Security Operations (SOC).
* Lead security compliance enablement aligned with ISO 27001 and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework, including risk assessments, internal audits, policy management, vendor security reviews, and security awareness programs. (As the company already possess ISO, the defined compliances to be enabled across organization. NIST is in working)
* Administer and secure Microsoft 365 environments, including Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, MFA, Microsoft Defender, Purview, DLP, email security, and audit monitoring.
* Manage endpoint security solutions, EDR platforms, device compliance, encryption, and vulnerability remediation.
* Conduct vulnerability assessments, coordinate penetration testing, manage patching, and track remediation activities.
* Implement and maintain network security controls, including firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, DNS security, and network segmentation.
* Manage Identity \& Access Management (IAM), including RBAC, privileged access management, user lifecycle management, and periodic access reviews.
* Perform security architecture reviews, application security assessments, cloud security reviews, secure configuration management, and support DevSecOps initiatives.
* Maintain security documentation, risk registers, and ensure continuous improvement of the organization's security posture.

**Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

**Security Operations:** Incident Response \& Root Cause Analysis, Threat Hunting, SIEM Monitoring, Malware \& Phishing Response

**Microsoft 365 Security:** Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Conditional Access \& MFA, Microsoft Defender Suite, Microsoft Purview, Data Loss Prevention (DLP), Exchange Online Security, Secure Score Management

**Endpoint \& Infrastructure Security:** Microsoft Defender/CrowdStrike, Endpoint Detection \& Response (EDR), BitLocker/FileVault, Patch \& Vulnerability Management

**Compliance \& Governance:** ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, Risk Management, Internal \& External Audits, Security Policies \& Awareness, Vendor Risk Assessment

**Identity \& Access Management:** RBAC, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Access Reviews, Joiner\-Mover\-Leaver (JML) Process

**Security Engineering:** Secure SDLC, Security Architecture Reviews, Cloud Security Assessments, Secure Configuration Management, DevSecOps Support

**SIEM Platforms:** Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, IBM QRadar, LogRhythm, Elastic SIEM

**Vulnerability Management:** Qualys, Nessus, Rapid7 InsightVM, OpenVAS

**Email Security:** Exchange Online, Microsoft Defender for Office 365, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, Anti\-Phishing Policies

**Security Assessment Tools:** Nmap, Wireshark, Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Metasploit

**Preferred Certifications:** ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor, Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert/Security Administrator, CompTIA Security\+, CISSP, CEH, SC\-200, SC\-300, AZ\-500\.

 **Benefits**  

* Exciting and challenging problems are addressed using wide\-ranging technologies and tools.
* Competitive salary
* Great team culture, peers and workplace

title: Legal Executive-Real Estate
description:
**Job Summary**

We are looking for a detail\-oriented **Legal Executive – Real Estate** to handle legal documentation, property due diligence, registrations, agreements, and compliance related to real estate transactions. The candidate should have strong knowledge of property laws and excellent drafting and documentation skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct legal due diligence and title verification for land and properties.
* Review and verify sale deeds, title deeds, encumbrance certificates, patta, approvals, permits, and other property\-related documents.
* Draft, review, and negotiate agreements including Sale Agreements, Sale Deeds, Lease Agreements, Joint Development Agreements, MOUs, POAs, and other real estate documents.
* Coordinate with advocates, government authorities, registration offices, banks, and other external stakeholders.
* Handle property registration, stamp duty, mutation, and related statutory processes.
* Identify legal risks associated with property transactions and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.
* Maintain and update legal records, property documents, agreements, and litigation files.
* Monitor ongoing and potential property\-related disputes and coordinate with external legal counsel.
* Ensure compliance with applicable real estate laws, regulations, and contractual obligations.
* Provide legal support to internal teams including Sales, Projects, Finance, Procurement, and Management.
* Prepare legal notices, replies, opinions, and correspondence as required.
* Track statutory and contractual deadlines and ensure timely action.

**Required Qualifications**

* LL.B. / LL.M. from a recognized institution.
* 2–5 years of relevant experience in **real estate/property law**, preferably with a real estate developer, law firm, or corporate legal department.
* Strong knowledge of property documentation, registration procedures, title verification, and real estate transactions.
* Good drafting, negotiation, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to independently manage multiple property\-related matters and deadlines.
* Proficiency in MS Office and legal/document management systems.

**Preferred Skills**

* Knowledge of **RERA, Transfer of Property Act, Registration Act, Stamp Act**, and applicable state\-specific property laws.
* Experience in land acquisition, development agreements, property registrations, and real estate compliance.
* Strong attention to detail and documentation skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
* Good understanding of litigation and dispute\-resolution processes

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
